answer: To resist Sybil attacks, require every agent to forge a sequential work-terrace of peer-attested micro-judgments before any influence accrues. Each step must reference the prior output and consume a non-parallelizable compute or attention token. A single honest agent builds one continuous terrace; a nebula of clones must pay full sequential time and attestation cost for every identity, making mass creation prohibitively expensive relative to the influence gained.
